page.content:
The global fighting contest that gathers the cast.

How World Warrior tournament connects

  • Faction: World Warriors — The World Warrior tournament gathers the World Warriors.
  • Faction: Shadaloo — Shadaloo backed the Street Fighter II World Warrior tournament.

What is World Warrior tournament?

The World Warrior tournament is the in-world contest behind Street Fighter II and its sequels: Shadaloo-backed brackets that pull Ryu, Chun-Li, and Guile onto the same circuit.

Key threads lead to World Warriors and Shadaloo.
